title: Txn_Jatin experiment registry
claim_boundary: Research-use-only. Cancer and immunotherapy analyses are exploratory and do not establish clinically validated biomarkers.

models.label: Txn_Jatin
models.note: Final 20-epoch static checkpoint; reconstruction plus ESM2, contextual, and sample-contrastive objectives.

models.label: Txn_Jatin OSDR LoRA
models.note: Rank-4 LoRA on attention and FFN projections in the last three layers; 0.24% trainable parameters.

models.label: Txn_Jatin contextual
models.note: Expression-conditioned hidden states averaged across 20,000 ARCHS4 samples; no standalone decoder.

models.label: BulkFormer-37M
models.note: Native bulk-expression decoder and static learned gene embeddings.

models.label: BulkFormer-50M
models.note: Native bulk-expression decoder and static learned gene embeddings.

models.label: BulkFormer-93M
models.note: Native bulk-expression decoder and static learned gene embeddings.

models.label: BulkFormer-127M
models.note: Native bulk-expression decoder and static learned gene embeddings.

models.label: BulkFormer-147M
models.note: Native bulk-expression decoder and static learned gene embeddings.

models.label: ESM2 PCA-512 prior
models.note: Protein-sequence embeddings projected to 512 dimensions; benchmark control, no expression decoder.

models.label: ESM3
models.note: Native frozen ESM3 sequence embeddings; mean-pooled final-layer residues with BOS/EOS excluded.

models.label: Geneformer
models.note: Rank-value pseudo-cell embedding control; no validated bulk-expression decoder.

models.label: scGPT
models.note: Gene-encoder embedding control; no validated bulk-expression decoder.

experiments.title: ARCHS4 pretraining
experiments.protocol: Final 20-epoch run over 958,212 training and 20,000 validation samples; 15% random masking; log1p-TPM.
experiments.conclusion: Logged validation reconstruction loss declined from 0.0869 to 0.0781. The checkpoint also optimized ESM2 prior, contextual alignment, and sample-contrastive terms.

experiments.title: Epoch-7 checkpoint comparison
experiments.protocol: Frozen full-corpus contextual embeddings; paired on 14,567 shared genes.
experiments.conclusion: Txn_Jatin epoch 7 led centroid functional prediction, while BRIDGE retained stronger same-set neighborhood ranking.

experiments.title: Pinned GitHub gene-embedding protocol
experiments.protocol: ylaboratory/gene-embedding-benchmarks-compatible holdout evaluation; 11 models, 29 groups, 319 rows. ANDES was excluded.
experiments.conclusion: Txn_Jatin was strongest on GO among learned expression models, while model rankings varied materially across disease and gene-pair domains.

experiments.title: Expression-context embedding benchmark
experiments.protocol: Contextual hidden states accumulated across ARCHS4, then evaluated on gene-set, pair, GO, and disease tracks.
experiments.conclusion: BRIDGE ranked first at 0.6437; Txn_Jatin ranked second at 0.6357. Context helped both over their static full-track means.

experiments.title: 15% whole-gene masking
experiments.protocol: The same 2,188 genes were hidden across all samples on a 14,585-gene common universe; three seeds; TCGA and OSDR.
experiments.conclusion: Txn_Jatin led TCGA expressed-gene AUROC (0.9284); BRIDGE led global PCC/MSE and all OSDR reconstruction metrics.

experiments.title: Cancer-gene identification
experiments.protocol: Patient-grouped five-fold random forests for 2-cancer and 5-cancer panels, using masked/imputed genes.
experiments.conclusion: All native decoders preserved near-ceiling tumor-versus-normal signal. These are internal TCGA discrimination results, not validated biomarkers.

experiments.title: OSDR gradual unfreezing and LoRA
experiments.protocol: Accession-grouped split; 20 epochs; head-only, BitFit/Norm, last 1-3 layers, and three LoRA configurations.
experiments.conclusion: Last-3 unfreezing minimized MSE (0.3177); last-3 attention+FFN LoRA maximized flight-vs-ground AUROC (0.6547) and was selected by the predeclared combined-rank rule.

experiments.title: Individual GO terms with ESM3
experiments.protocol: Forty frozen GO-BP terms; five-fold out-of-fold GPU linear probes; strict 13,408-gene ESM3 comparison.
experiments.conclusion: ESM3 (0.7817) and ESM2 (0.7808) led sequence-aligned GO recovery; BulkFormer-147M led the expression-model group.

experiments.title: Sparse-panel biomarker feasibility
experiments.protocol: Only 1,000 or 2,000 genes observed; 86-93% of the vocabulary hidden; internal TCGA endpoints.
experiments.conclusion: Literal sparse-panel reconstruction failed (PCC about 0.009; expression AUROC about 0.505). Strong phenotype scores did not validate hidden-gene recovery and must not be framed as biomarker discovery.

experiments.title: Exploratory immunotherapy transfer
experiments.protocol: Four public ICI cohorts, n=239; nested leave-one-cohort-out logistic evaluation; frozen Txn_Jatin features; explicit pretraining-overlap audit.
experiments.conclusion: Raw expression led macro AUROC (0.6535); Txn-completed expression reached 0.6361; context features were dominated by cohort. IFN-alpha and IFN-gamma response pathways were concordantly higher in responders, but the study is exploratory.

experiments.title: Official individual GO benchmark on TCGA genes
experiments.protocol: Pinned ylaboratory/gene-embedding-benchmarks commit d1320026a2a4ee033d49517f91e2d1c2ccc8df1e; all 56 official GO terms; fixed nested-CV folds and holdout SVC; native and 9,568-gene strict TCGA scopes.
experiments.conclusion: Txn_Jatin ranked first in both scopes (AUROC 0.8353 native; 0.8439 strict), followed by ESM2 and Txn_Jatin contextual. Native 1,536-dimensional ESM3 ranked fourth.
